description: SW-fps is a 15-hour face-to-face training programme developed by Armstrong and colleagues to prepare practising social workers to deliver brief cognitive-behavioural strategies for common mental-health disorders.
title: SW-fps

description: NASA's Swift mission formal-education curriculum package comprises standards-aligned classroom guides, units, posters, videos, and related materials for middle-school through early-college science learners.
title: Swift formal education curriculum materials

description: A suite of SSU-maintained public websites providing gamma-ray-burst and space-science information, an astronomy guessing game, and a multilingual educational webcomic with supporting definitions and multimedia links.
title: Swift public-facing web resources: GRB Skymap site, GRB Lotto game, and Epo's Chronicles weekly webcomic

description: Switch-on Reading is a one-to-one, 10-week graded-book reading intervention developed for weak Year 7 readers and delivered by trained staff using a prescribed session protocol and running-record assessment.
title: Switch-on Reading
